description_target.ambiguity_notes: Starred case. Training examples can cover only some opening orientations, so a descriptor or generator that omits right/left/top/bottom symmetry may pass train while failing held-out. There are several visually plausible fill policies unless opening side, diagonal tip extension, and interior fill are all specified.
negative_constraints: Generate exactly one nonzero non-fill shape color.
Do not generate a closed rectangle or a shape with multiple open sides.
Include all four opening orientations in validation sets.
Keep arm tips separated enough that the opening is detectable.
Avoid preexisting fill-color cells that could be mistaken for the answer region.
solution_steps: Identify the shape color, excluding background and fill color 4.
Collect all cells of that color and compute the bounding box.
Check which bbox side is not fully occupied by the shape color.
Find the two arm tips on that open side.
Paint color 4 along the tip diagonals and through the concavity/interior region for that orientation.
description_target.target_text: Fill a C/U-shaped object's concavity with color 4, extending diagonally outward from the arm tips on the open side and filling the interior/opening region implied by that side.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; A C-shaped frame of one color has an OPEN mouth on one side.
 ;; Yellow(4) pours in: rows level with the mouth interior flood with 4
 ;; from the outside wall through the cavity, the two arm-tip rows get
 ;; a 4 just outside the mouth plus a cavity fill, and beyond the tips
 ;; the 4s run away as 45-degree diagonal spouts. Normalize so the
 ;; mouth faces LEFT (flip/transpose), pour once, map back.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define sc  ;; the frame's color: first non-0 non-4 value
       (find-first (lambda (v) (and (> v 0) (not (= v 4))))
                   (remove-duplicates (apply append g))))
     (define (tips-of pos)  ;; mouth tips: run ends flanking the gap
       (let* ((sp (sort pos <))
              (gaps (filter (lambda (i) (> (- (nth sp (+ i 1)) (nth sp i)) 1))
                            (range 0 (- (length sp) 1)))))
         (list (if (empty? gaps) (first sp) (nth sp (last gaps)))
               (if (empty? gaps) (last sp) (nth sp (+ (first gaps) 1))))))
     (define (pour grid)  ;; mouth faces LEFT
       (let* ((hh (rows grid)) (ww (cols grid))
              (cells (find-color grid sc))
              (r1 (min-of first cells)) (r2 (max-of first cells))
              (c1 (min-of second cells)) (c2 (max-of second cells))
              (tips (tips-of (filter (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c1) sc))
                                     (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))
              (tt (first tips)) (bt (second tips))
              (mouth-c (- c1 1))
              (flood (lambda (out r cs)
                       (for/fold ((a out)) ((c cs))
                         (if (zero? (at grid r c)) (set-cell a r c 4) a)))))
         (for/fold ((out grid)) ((r (range 0 hh)))
           (cond ((< r tt)
                  (let ((yc (- mouth-c (- tt r))))
                    (if (and (>= yc 0) (< yc ww) (zero? (at grid r yc)))
                        (set-cell out r yc 4)
                        out)))
                 ((> r bt)
                  (let ((yc (- mouth-c (- r bt))))
                    (if (and (>= yc 0) (< yc ww) (zero? (at grid r yc)))
                        (set-cell out r yc 4)
                        out)))
                 ((or (= r tt) (= r bt))
                  (flood (set-cell out r mouth-c 4)
                         r (range (+ c1 1) (+ c2 1))))
                 (else (flood out r (range 0 (+ c2 1))))))))
     (let* ((cells (find-color g sc))
            (r1 (min-of first cells)) (r2 (max-of first cells))
            (c1 (min-of second cells)) (c2 (max-of second cells))
            (full (lambda (fixed by-row?)
                    (all? (lambda (k) (= (at g (if by-row? fixed k)
                                            (if by-row? k fixed))
                                         sc))
                          (if by-row? (range c1 (+ c2 1))
                              (range r1 (+ r2 1)))))))
       (cond ((not (full c1 #f)) (pour g))
             ((not (full c2 #f)) (flip-lr (pour (flip-lr g))))
             ((not (full r1 #t)) (transpose (pour (transpose g))))
             ((not (full r2 #t))
              (transpose (flip-lr (pour (flip-lr (transpose g))))))
             (else g))))))
